gloss: public road; local road; ordinary road

definitions.gloss: public road; local road; ordinary road
definitions.explanation: A regular road as opposed to an expressway or highway. In Japan, this refers to toll-free roads with intersections and traffic lights, as distinct from toll expressways.

examples.japanese: {一般道|いっぱんどう}を{走|はし}る。
examples.english: To drive on a local road.

examples.japanese: {高速|こうそく}を{使|つか}わず{一般道|いっぱんどう}で{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went by local roads without using the expressway.

examples.japanese: {渋滞|じゅうたい}を{避|さ}けるため、{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}を{降|お}りて{一般道|いっぱんどう}に{切|き}り{替|か}えた。
examples.english: To avoid the traffic jam, I exited the expressway and switched to local roads.

notes:
Short form of {一般道路|いっぱんどうろ}: {一般|いっぱん} (general, ordinary) + {道|どう} (road). Contrasts with {高速道路|こうそくどうろ} (expressway). Navigation systems and traffic reports use this term frequently.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一般道|いっぱんどう}を{走|はし}る (to drive on local roads)
- {一般道|いっぱんどう}に{降|お}りる (to get off onto local roads)
- {一般道|いっぱんどう}の{制限速度|せいげんそくど} (speed limit on local roads)
